topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: The room feels suddenly too large, the walls stretching out in the quiet. I blink, the phone's message still sinking in, the words stark against the screen. The party, it seems, won't happen. The anticipation, the smiles I imagined, all now quieted. Outside, the shadows grow long, the day slipping away. I find myself checking the time, each tick louder in the stillness. The plans, the preparations, all set in motion, now must be stopped. I don’t know what to do with this space that opens up, this sudden emptiness where the buzz of excitement once was. The room feels heavier, the air thick. I wonder what to do, how to fill this new, unexpected quiet.
